name: SJT class ROUV
maker: Shenyang Institute of Automation and Shanghai Jiao Tong University
def: Chinese family of remotely operated underwater vehicles created as a joint project of the Shenyang Institute of Automation and the underwater engineering institute of Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
facts: General designer was Zhu Jimao, a Shanghai Jiao Tong University professor
Zhu Jimao also designed the earlier Type 7103 DSRV
Experience from the series fed into many later Chinese ROUVs
